criteria.deficiency: The renderer indexes control_code[1] directly instead of using the file's cast(...) convention. Under the repo's strict mypy typecheck this is likely to produce two errors: a tuple-index-out-of-range error for the length-1 union member and an arg-type error for Union[int, str] passed to set_title(str). The fix is `_, title = cast(Tuple[ControlType, str], control_code)` followed by term.set_title(title), as in the reference. Otherwise the naming, docstrings, changelog entry, and test style follow the repo conventions.
